Compose a medium-close work portrait: face around 47 percent from left, both hands grouped centrally below her face; keep face and hands within central 60 percent for a mobile crop. The grower looks at the plants, not the lens. Visually calm edges. Realistic documentary camera, subtle texture and natural contrast. No type, logos, watermarks, glamour styling, name, visible writing, or identifiable real individual. One decisive moment.
